decision.section: Iterate — bug: one source for the last audit run date
decision.title: One minted run instant feeds audit md, json and dashboard
decision.context: audit-report.md stamped its own wall-clock Generated date while the dashboard read the tracked last_audit record, so they could name different audits as current.
decision.decision: AuditReport carries ran_at, minted once in run_audit and passed to the tracked record, so md Generated, json and record agree by construction. Tracked documents (dashboard, every provenance header) read ONLY the tracked last_audit record. The local json feeds only the md staleness banner, which names the newest recorded run; an empty run writes no json.
decision.consequences: md, json and dashboard show one date in the normal case; an older md says a newer run exists. A newer local json changes no tracked document. A json with empty groups_run or no findings list is ignored. If the record write fails, the local md and json run ahead of the tracked dashboard; only the stderr warning says so. A consumer project that tracks audit-report.md has a banner that depends on the local json; acceptable, as md and json are written as a pair.
decision.rationale: Threading one value through existing artifacts adds no mechanism; both external reviewers and the architecture review approved this size.
decision.rejected: Promoting the gitignored json into tracked documents: an empty typo run (--only Z) or a run whose record failed would be shown as a newer run (H1); it would reach all five evidence provenance headers and break their machine-independence (H2); the json survives git checkout so main could cite another branch's run. Also rejected: warning-only banner.

changelog.bullet: fix(compliance): audit-report.md, audit-report.json and the dashboard now show the same last audit run date; a stale report is flagged when a newer run is on record

behaviors.behavior: md, json and dashboard show the same last-run date on a fixture
a stale md older than the recorded run is flagged with the newer UTC date
tracked documents read only the tracked record; a newer local json changes none of them
an empty run (--only typo) changes neither the dashboard, the md nor the banner

finalize.reason: iterate: one source for the last audit run date

event_extras.description: audit report and dashboard share one last-run date
event_extras.summary: The audit report and the dashboard now name the same audit run date, and an outdated report says that a newer run exists.
event_extras.spec_impact_justification: Restores the documented behaviour that compliance documents agree on when the audit last ran; no requirement changes.

affected_acs.why: Compliance evidence is still generated from the same data; only the run date source changed.
